speech: A chargeback leaves a small merchant with a claim to investigate and evidence to assemble. Rebuttal brings that review into a case file.
This is a recorded prototype using synthetic merchant records. The case groups order history, delivery records, and checkout terms so the reviewer can inspect the supporting material.
The same view identifies missing evidence. Here, the signature on file is absent. A missing record is a reason to investigate, not proof that the customer is wrong.
A high value case calls for human judgment. This recorded case is awaiting an owner reply. The visible screen is the earlier SMS interface; live delivery and session resume are not shown here.

Rebuttal uses Strands Agents and Bedrock AgentCore to support evidence gathering and decision review. This walkthrough shows the case review experience, without claiming a real dispute win or measured savings.
